title: 32 feet per second.
html_source:
Reference to the rate of accelation of falling bodies that Bloom ruminated on in Chapter 5. “Thirtytwo feet per second per second. Law of falling bodies”.

Bloom’s deterministic thinking contrasts with the experimental philosophy of Stephen in Proteus.
